title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B = 4/3 T (≈1.33 T) using the force balance and circuit equations.

title: Force balance analysis
description: Important: Sets up proper equilibrium equations for both limiting angles (37° and 90°) considering gravity, friction, and magnetic force.

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes circuit current I = E/(R+r) = 7.5 A using Ohm's law with both resistances.

title: Velocity at cf
description: Essential: Correctly finds v = 3 m/s using work-energy theorem with friction and gravitational potential energy.

title: Acceleration after switch closure
description: Essential: Correctly calculates acceleration ≈ 6.07 m/s² considering magnetic force, friction, and gravity components.

title: Friction coefficient determination
description: Important: Solves for μ = 0.5 from the equilibrium conditions at the limiting angles.

title: Direction consistency
description: Optional: Correctly identifies magnetic field direction (vertical downward) from force analysis.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign assignment for friction force direction when rod is stationary or moving.

title: Circuit resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include both internal resistance r and rod resistance R in total circuit resistance.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Uses inconsistent units (e.g., mixing degrees/radians, omitting g=10 m/s²) in calculations.
